environment: Isolated dedicated server, Java 21, Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.248, Create 6.0.10; minimal Create dependencies, not the full Mechanomania pack.
observed: An authorized one-block monitor was created through MCP at overworld (9,128,8), using a 20-tick interval.

History contained actual create:shaft samples with RPM -8, theoretical RPM -8, cached capacity 256 SU and cached consumption 64 SU; these runtime samples were not independently checked against a game instrument.

A separately authorized construction operation removed the shaft; history subsequently contained minecraft:air samples. A new authorized operation restored the shaft and history again contained create:shaft.

After graceful shutdown and restart the monitor and retained history were accessible, an explicit restart_observation_gap was present, and later samples were appended. The test did not exercise power loss.

The final build loaded the same monitor and reported historyTruncated=true after 64 retained events. Temporarily disabling the isolated work-area configuration made monitor, history and metric queries return not_found; the original test configuration bytes were restored.

performance.interpretation: Single local calls, not a benchmark; TPS, MSPT, GC and storage growth not measured.

limits: Prototype only: at most 16 monitors, 64 positions per monitor, four visits and a soft one-millisecond budget per tick; individual mod calls and policy file I/O can exceed the budget.
JSONL is limited to 4 MiB; at the limit persistence fails closed. No compaction, automatic retention, aggregation, long-term history database or configurable disk budget is implemented.
History queries retain at most the last 64 events per monitor in memory and now report truncation; arbitrary historical time ranges and windows are not implemented.
Sampling is periodic rather than event-driven; short-lived changes may be missed. Cross-tick samples are not atomic. Unloaded chunks are not loaded and create gaps.

Unsided capabilities may be unavailable or incomplete. Inventory differences are net changes only; no transfer or production counters, fluid flow, throughput, utilization curves or efficiency calculations are claimed.
Queue acknowledgement is not durability; bounded shutdown flush may time out. Abrupt crash and incomplete-tail recovery require further work.
Trusted policy is checked synchronously against disk; this fails closed on revocation but can itself stall the server thread and is not a scalable design.
